description: Meet Ron Stewart, a dedicated firefighter turned public servant, campaigning for Oklahoma State House District 73. Committed to bringing courage, resilience, and community-driven change to Tulsa, Ron champions voting rights, small business growth, quality education, accessible healthcare, and public safety. Join us in creating a brighter future for every resident of District 73
